faq_heading: Questions owners ask about custom AI agents

faqs.q: Do I need a tech team to use a custom AI agent?
faqs.a: No. Clara AI handles the build, deployment and ongoing management, so your staff only need to review results and give feedback.

faqs.q: Can a custom AI agent connect to the systems I already use?
faqs.a: Yes. It is built to work with your existing CRM, ERP, email and spreadsheets, so you do not have to replace them.

faqs.q: Will a custom AI agent replace my staff?
faqs.a: No. It takes over repetitive tasks, and your team keeps control of decisions, exceptions and customer relationships.

faqs.q: What languages do Clara AI's chatbots and calling agents support?
faqs.a: They work in English and Hindi.

faqs.q: How quickly can I see a working demo?
faqs.a: Clara AI delivers a first demo within 7 days of receiving your material.
